notes: New look: all 15 heroes have painted faces, and their weapons now sit in their hands and strike harder.
Run cards: pick a card every 15 zones, then Seal the best ones into your deck when you destroy the Ring.
The Ring Forge: spend Ring Shards on lasting damage upgrades and on control over your card picks.
Legendary Powers: rare build-changing cards with a Keep or Scrap choice.
The Star Forge: reach zone 500 to reforge the world, earn Star Iron and grow faster every layer.
Buy All: one button buys every hero upgrade you can afford, cheapest first (hotkey U).
Your old save upgrades itself: shards spent on old Ring Powers come back, and Ring Echo keeps you at least as strong.
First beta for friends: 15 heroes, five zones, bosses, the Ring, achievements and music.
The game updates itself when a new version is out.
